data.name: Arisen Force: Vonimir
data.detailed_description:
A Tale of Swords and Sorcery from Another World

Summoned by mysterious powers, you are drawn into a conspiracy of blood and darkness. In the vast fantasy realm of Vonimir, guided by the prophecy of the Hero King, you will embark on a journey to save the world and fight alongside your companions. Gather your allies, repel the rising shadows, and gradually unveil the secrets of this world.

Arisen Force: Vonimir is an A-RPG that blends exquisite HD pixel art, fast-paced action combat, and the charm of medieval fantasy adventure. As the next evolution of the Arisen Force series, this title deepens the combat system while enriching the story, exploration, and adventure elements.

Features

  • Exhilarating Combat: A finely polished action system featuring dodge, heavy strikes, parries, blade clashes, finishing moves, precision timing, cancels, and more.

  • Eight Weapon Modules: Daggers, longswords, claymore, katanas, spears, bows, staves, and gauntlets—each with unique branching skills and combat techniques.

  • Deep Tactical Play: Instantly switch teammates, execute cooperative combos, master precise swaps, and unleash the Odin Ultimate and Crow Spirit systems.

  • Flexible Builds: Freely swap equipment and skills, reset a universal talent tree, and combine with character-exclusive abilities for countless playstyles.

  • Intense Boss Battles: Bosses feature multi-phase encounters, counterattacks, grapples, defensive mechanics, and even devastating combo or fusion attacks.

  • Journey Skills: Steal, duel, scout, break hidden seals, and discover treasures to enrich your exploration.

  • Stunning Pixel Art: From villages to castles, deserts to icy plains, experience a world that feels like a living painting.

  • Immersive Environments: Towns and landscapes shift dynamically through dawn, day, dusk, and night.

  • A Story of Fate: Slowly uncover the destiny of a traveler ensnared in otherworldly conspiracies and the true path of Vonimir.

  • Trusted Companions: Rescue and recruit allies, equip them with gear and skills, and build your exclusive fighting force.

  • Flavors of the Journey: Beyond the main adventure, enjoy taverns, forging, enchanting, crafting, dismantling, and a variety of side activities.

Storyline

A noble lineage sworn to protect peace is ensnared in a world-shaking conspiracy, leaving Aurelia—the last surviving heir—trapped in certain doom. At this moment, Dirus, a traveler from the modern world, takes up the mantle as the only hope. You are the hero of this world!

With the Hero King’s prophecy pointing to you, the chosen one, you must survive, clear your name, and set out on a quest to uncover the Hero King’s fate while rebuilding the fallen fortress. Alongside Aurelia and companions from across rival factions, you will march forward together to reveal the deepest secrets hidden within the land of Vonimir.

  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon™ RX 460 / NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 750
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon™ RX 470 / Intel® Arc™ A750 / NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1060 6GB VRAM
